positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Currently working as part of the Billing team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-As part of the Report Generator Team, implemented functionality in MATLAB to include video files to PowerPoint reports by directly adding them to internal PowerPoint XML files 
-Acclimated to the team by rapidly learning new technologies, such as OpenXML formatting schemas and Antenna House PDF Formatter's C++ interface
-Adapted to the introduction of multiple different AI tools and integrated them into development workflows to increase efficiency
-Effectively communicated design decisions and ideas through reports and presentations, and constantly collaborated with team members

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Programmed a repository for storing machine learning object metadata in Python using a MySQL database powered by SQLAlchemy.
-Developed and pushed new UI functionality to the Feast open-source repo, such as a custom JSON metadata tab and pages for individual features.
-Quickly and efficiently learned how to utilize internal Twitter architecture and tooling in order to host a service on the Mesos clusters.
-Managed collaboration with multiple teams at once and handled many large scope increases up until the end of the project.

positions.title: ML Intern
positions.description:
-Programmed an OSS TensorFlow component that randomly over/undersampled a dataset.
-Implemented information derived from XGBoost models within a TensorFlow component.
-Wrote docs and tests for my TF components, and integrated them in ML pipelines using TFX.
-Learned processes for adding functionality to and fixing bugs in very large codebases.
-Presented results concisely, and frequently communicated with manager and mentor.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
-Automated and checked correctness of web-based tasks in parallel using Python and Selenium.
-Utilized and integrate multiple AWS services with Python, such as DynamoDB and S3.
-Made wide-ranging bugfixes with a small team to an existing codebase to ensure functionality.
-Wrote extensive documentation on codebase additions, and communicated daily with the team.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
-Program packages in Python to examine, classify and visualize sparse and high-dimensional data quickly.
-Constructed software to handle large amounts of data, streamline lab pipeline, and automate workflow.
-Analyze time, space, and complexity trade-offs for software development and machine learning model selection.
-Implemented and compared various machine learning models to classify breakpoint DNA junctions.
-Performed research using machine learning on structural variants and improved software development skills.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
-Constructed a robust and adaptive parser to gather information from inconsistently-formatted medical reports.
-Analyzed, cleaned, and prepared large amounts of patient data to prepare them for medical image matching.

positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description:
-Helped develop for Vesta, Yale's web-based housing program, as part of a large team of programmers and developers under the Student Developer and Mentorship Program.
-Trained by creating live, user-based web applications, and finished an integrative final project by creating a web-application from scratch.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
-Performed research as part of the Simons Summer Research Program at Stony Brook.
-Analyzed public data using Python on obesity, economic factors, and demographic characteristics, and learned to use ArcMap software and to utilize spatial statistical features to create new methods of analysis and to visually present results efficiently.
-Wrote two research papers, which have since been published in the journal Preventing Chronic Disease.

publications.title: Factors Affecting Obesity and Waist Circumference Among US Adults
Geographic Association Between Income Inequality and Obesity Among Adults in New York State

organizations.name: r/AskHistorians Bot Team
organizations.description:
-Wrote and maintained the r/AskHistorians Weekly Digest Bot, currently used by 24,000+ users
-Focused on maintainability and durability, making the bot's design as simple as possible in order to maximize ease of future development and updates
-Communicated with Reddit Admin team concerning PM/chat rate limits and API changes, and with the r/AskHistorians team on requirements and functionality

organizations.name: Yale Undergraduate Research Association
organizations.description:
-Currently assisting and advising students to help them integrate themselves into Yale's research community, as well as to help them secure various research projects.
-As a member of the Postgrad/Grad-School Initiative Committee, planning post-grad fellowship workshops with other members.
-Developing and providing upkeep for Yale’s Research Database and YURA’s website.
-Assisting in planning for YURA's annual research symposium.
